dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with a prominent triangular notch located at approximately 25% of the total height from the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Narrowly rounded apex with a small pixel radius, forming an acute-to-obtuse transition point between the leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steeply convex anterior margin oriented at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical height to maximum base width ratio of approximately 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, broad convex curve with a large radius forming the anterior-dorsal boundary of the cranium.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust visible extension; proportional length is low relative to thickness due to perspective-induced foreshortening.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle of approximately 150 degrees visible at the transition point from the melon to the dorsal rostrum surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct V-shaped notch on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; large irregular white depigmented patch/scar on the right mid-flank area.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-contrast light pigmentation zone on the lateral flank extending ventrally from the posterior insertion of the dorsal fin.
